wiki.summary: “What Did I Miss?” is a reflective track where Drake confronts betrayal and shifting loyalties in the aftermath of 2024’s rap civil war. He questions how people he once supported, through collaborations, tours, and personal relationships, ended up siding with his rivals. wiki.content: “What Did I Miss?” is a reflective track where Drake confronts betrayal and shifting loyalties in the aftermath of 2024’s rap civil war. He questions how people he once supported, through collaborations, tours, and personal relationships, ended up siding with his rivals. The recurring refrain, “What did I miss?”, captures both disbelief and introspection, as he tries to understand where things went left. The song premiered during a YouTube stream on July 4, 2025, titled ICEMAN EPISODE 1, where Drake plays a worker on his lunch break watching old clips of himself in Toronto, followed by the music video. It was released on all DSPs the next day. Read more on Last.fm. User-contributed text is available under the Creative Commons By-SA License; additional terms may apply.
